articles.title: Littelfuse Expands IXD Series Gate Driver Portfolio with New High-Current Options
articles.summary: Littelfuse announces expansion of the popular IXD series gate drivers, introducing new variants with enhanced current capability and improved thermal performance for demanding automotive and industrial applications.
articles.content:
Littelfuse has expanded its industry-leading IXD series gate driver portfolio with new high-current variants designed to meet the evolving demands of electric vehicle powertrains and industrial motor drives. The new additions include enhanced versions of the IXDD630CI with improved thermal packaging and the introduction of dual-channel configurations for compact inverter designs.

Key improvements in the expanded portfolio include:
- Enhanced peak current capability up to 35A for driving latest SiC MOSFETs
- Improved thermal resistance enabling higher switching frequencies
- Extended operating voltage range supporting emerging 48V automotive systems
- New AEC-Q100 Grade 0 qualification for under-hood applications

These enhancements address the growing demand for higher power density in EV traction inverters and industrial drives while maintaining the reliability and performance that Littelfuse customers expect.

articles.title: Littelfuse Achieves AEC-Q100 Grade 0 Qualification for Gate Driver Portfolio
articles.summary: Littelfuse announces AEC-Q100 Grade 0 qualification for its entire IXD series gate driver portfolio, enabling deployment in the most demanding under-hood automotive applications.
articles.content:
Littelfuse has successfully completed AEC-Q100 Grade 0 qualification for its complete IXD series gate driver portfolio, representing a significant milestone for automotive power electronics applications. Grade 0 qualification extends the operating temperature range to -40°C to +150°C, enabling deployment in under-hood environments where extreme temperatures are encountered.

This qualification covers:
- IXDD609SI, IXDN609SI, IXDI609SI (9A drivers)
- IXDD614SI (14A driver with enable)
- IXDD630CI (30A high-current driver)

The qualification process included extensive reliability testing including High Temperature Operating Life (HTOL), Temperature Cycling, and Early Life Failure Rate (ELFR) testing. All devices demonstrated exceptional reliability performance exceeding automotive industry requirements.

This achievement reinforces Littelfuse's commitment to supporting the rapidly growing electric vehicle market with qualified, reliable components for critical powertrain applications.
